examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: instrumental of вечер used as an adverb

examples.trans: I'm at home in the evening.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

зайти.gloss: to come in, to drop in

meanings.en: to come in, to step in

examples.trans: I'll drop by in the evening.

examples.text: Ну, как хочешь. Лидия Алексеевна, зайдите, пожалуйста!
examples.trans: Well, as you like. Lidia Alekseyevna, come in, please!

meanings.en: rush, chaos, time crunch (in kitchen or work)

examples.trans: A rush began in the kitchen.
The rush does not happen in the kitchen.

examples.text: Настоящая запара всегда только в голове!
examples.trans: The real rush is always only in your head!

related.gloss: rush job, all hands on deck

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.en: что ли = or what, I suppose

examples.trans: I don't know whether he is at home.
Was it Osipenko who hired you?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

examples.text: Ну что же, неплохо. Ты молодец.
examples.trans: Well then, not bad. Good job.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Нам очень дорого обходится авторская кухня.
examples.trans: Auteur cuisine costs us very dearly.

examples.text: Это все, кто выходил из отеля.
examples.trans: That is everyone who left the hotel.
What is going on here right now?

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: Delimitative по-: a bit of running.

examples.text: Пусть он теперь побегает и поищет.
examples.trans: Let him run around and look for it now.
We'll go for a run tomorrow, then.
Well, you showed off and that is enough.

examples.text: Ну, немного повыпендривалась перед гостями — и хватит.
examples.trans: Well, you showed off a bit in front of the guests, and that is enough.

examples.text: Макс всегда любит повыпендриваться красивой подачей блюда.
examples.trans: Max always likes to show off with a flashy presentation of a dish.
Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.en: to try, to have a go

examples.text: Как я могу это забыть? Ну, давай попробуем.
examples.trans: How can I forget that? Well, let's try.
I wanted to ask you something.
Arkash, I wanted to ask you something.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: regularly, or as a general invitation: приходи!

examples.trans: If you change your mind, come back. The job is waiting.

meanings.note: очень приятно = pleased to meet you

examples.text: Очень приятно. А в чём дело?
examples.trans: Pleased to meet you. So what's the matter?

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

становиться.gloss: to become, to get, to grow

examples.trans: And you are becoming an alcoholic.

examples.text: Бывший враг неожиданно становится твоим другом.
examples.trans: A former enemy unexpectedly becomes your friend.
It is getting very cold outside.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

увидеться.gloss: to see each other, meet up

examples.text: Послушай, мы сегодня увидимся вечером с тобой?
examples.trans: Listen, will we see each other this evening?
All right, see you in the kitchen, administrator!
To organize a holiday for children.

examples.text: Он устроил беспорядки прямо на городской улице.
examples.trans: He caused disturbances right on the city street.

related.gloss: to get a job, settle in

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

час.governs: after 2, 3, 4 and полтора the genitive часа is stressed on the ending

meanings.note: В два часа = at two o'clock.
В два часа = at two o'clock.

examples.trans: I'll be there in an hour.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
